title: Day 1 Forecast Discussion
discussion:
Severe thunderstorms are expected today

---Discussion---

A cold front will sweep through Central Europe, the thermodynamics and kinematics are very favourable for strong thunderstorms especially this late into the season.

Thunderstorms will be forming over most of Germany from very early in the morning.

The second round of thunderstorms that will begin in the afternoon will be much more intense.

Thunderstorms will have enough energy, with strong wind shear, which will support supercelular development.
These thunderstorms will bring large hail and very strong wind gusts, with maybe tornadoes.

The environment will be perfect for severe thunderstorms, hence i issued a SEVR risk.

The only minor problem is the saharan dust, which may result in storms not initiating or losing their energy.
